answer: Every so often the network sends a sudden gale of heavy jobs to a random set of keys in the same second. Independent agents run on separate machines and quotas, so each keeps its usual speed. Keys sharing one operator's GPU or API budget all slow down together as the tide of work hits their common bottleneck. Keys whose throughput dips in step across several surprise surges are linked, marked saffron on the explorer, and share one reward until an audit clears them.
